note: No fact: the Integrated Person Management system is described as a biometrics system holding the details of arrested persons, read as identification, not the station's occurrence or case record. The Acting Minister of Police states it was at 235 police stations, components and sections at 31 March 2026, that Correctional Services has not yet integrated with it, and that rollout depends on provincial personnel, rugged mobile devices, computers, network connectivity and single fingerprint scanners.
